title: Normalized district budget record, schema version 1.0
description: One record per district-fiscal-year. Deliberately coarse: a dozen rollup categories, not 400 line items. Two dimensions describe the SAME dollars and must never be summed together -- `expenditures` slices spending by function, `personnel` slices it by object class. A null money value means the source document did not publish that figure; it never means it was not looked for. That guarantee is enforced by the validator, which requires every null to be accounted for in `not_published` or `lines_flagged`.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was extracted under. Records extracted under 1.0 remain valid when 1.2 exists; the build reads the declared version and applies the matching validator.

entity.description: Registry slug of the district or supervisory union this budget belongs to.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year the budget covers. FY2027 = the year ending June 30, 2027.

status.description: Where in its lifecycle this budget was when the source document was published. A district-fiscal-year may legitimately have several records at different statuses; they are distinct rows, not revisions of one row.

source.description: Repo-relative path to the raw intake artifact this record was extracted from. CI rejects any record whose source path does not exist.

source_pages.description: Page or section reference within the source artifact, e.g. 'pp. 14-17' or 'Budget Summary table'. Makes a record checkable by hand in under a minute.

mapping.description: Path to the mapping file that drove the extraction, when one was used.

adopted_date.description: Date of the Town Meeting or board vote that adopted this budget, where applicable. Null for proposed/warned records.

extracted_by.description: Who performed or confirmed the extraction. Free text; a name or handle.

revenues.description: Revenue by source. Should sum to total_revenue where the document states one.

education_fund.description: Statewide Education Fund receipts -- the main line for most Vermont districts.

local.description: Locally raised revenue other than the education property tax: tuition received, fees, rentals, endowment.

total_stated.description: Total revenue as printed in the document. Preserved separately so a mismatch against the sum of the parts is visible rather than silently reconciled.

expenditures.description: Spending sliced BY FUNCTION, aligned to AOE's chart of accounts rollups. Never sum this block with `personnel` -- they describe the same dollars.

administration_district.description: District- and SU-level administration. This is the line consolidation scenarios act on most directly.

administration_school.description: Building-level administration. Follows the buildings in closure/merger scenarios, unlike administration_district.

total_stated.description: Total expenditure as printed. Preserved to expose reconciliation gaps rather than hide them.

personnel.description: The same dollars as `expenditures`, sliced BY OBJECT CLASS. Health insurance is broken out because it is the cost driver most board fights are actually about. Where a budget document does not publish this cut, the fields stay null and are listed in not_published -- never estimated.

total_staff_costs.description: Salaries + all benefits. A subset of total expenditures, not an addition to them.

benefits_health.description: Health insurance only. Modeled with its own separately adjustable trend rate because it grows even when headcount does not.

benefits_other.description: FICA, retirement, dental, life, disability, tuition reimbursement, and other non-health benefits.

fte.description: Headcount in full-time equivalents, where the budget document states it. AOE-published staffing data is joined in separately at normalization time and kept in a labeled parallel series -- it is never merged into these district-stated fields.

as_stated_note.description: How this document presents staffing -- which cuts it publishes, which it does not, and any wrinkle in reading them.

adm.description: Average daily membership as reported IN THE BUDGET DOCUMENT. AOE-published ADM is joined separately; where they disagree the discrepancy is recorded in membership_note, not reconciled.

adm_basis.description: What the document says its ADM figure is: which year, which count date, whether averaged.

equalized_pupils_stated.description: Weighted/equalized pupil count as printed by the district, if given. The engine's own recomputation lives in the precomputed baselines, not here.

membership_note.description: Any discrepancy between district-stated membership and AOE-reported ADM, stated plainly.

per_pupil.description: Both figures are kept. Districts' printed per-pupil numbers sometimes will not match a recomputation; that discrepancy is analytically interesting and must not be silently fixed.

as_stated_basis.description: What the district says its per-pupil figure divides by -- ADM, equalized pupils, weighted membership. Frequently the source of the discrepancy.

towns.description: One entry per member town, with the rate and CLA as stated in this document. Tax Department published CLAs and rates are joined separately and labeled as the state's figures.

homestead_rate_stated.description: Homestead education property tax rate in dollars per $100 of equalized value, as printed.

cla.description: Common Level of Appraisal as a ratio (0.8734), not a percentage (87.34).

not_published.description: Dotted paths of fields this source document does not publish, each confirmed absent by a human rather than merely skipped. The validator requires that every null in the record appears here or in lines_flagged. This is what makes a null mean 'the district did not publish it' instead of 'we did not look'.

lines_flagged.description: Anything that did not fit cleanly: line items spanning two rollup categories, figures that do not reconcile, apparent errors in the source, judgement calls made during extraction.
